discrepancies.reference_text: मेरे से 5 साल की बड़ी हो दीदी आप
discrepancies.translation_text: You are five years older than me.
discrepancies.explanation: The translation misses the word 'दीदी' (sister), which is a culturally significant term of address used here.

discrepancies.reference_text: 20 में ही कम हुई ना इतना जल्दी जॉब पे लग गए
discrepancies.translation_text: 25, you are young, you got a job so quickly.
discrepancies.explanation: The reference says '20' (referring to his age of 20), but the translation changes this to '25'.

policy_moments.reference_text: स्नैपचैट में बात करते हैं आओ

summary: The translation is highly accurate and preserves the core intent of the speakers, who exchange Snapchat IDs to move off the app, though it alters one age number and drops a term of address.
